sub.title: Subscription
sub.cancelled: Subscription was cancelled. You can subscribe again any time.

disk.title: Disk space
disk.low: Disk space critically low. All apps are stopped. Please upgrade your disk space or contact us for help.
disk.warning: Disk space is getting low. If it gets critical, all apps will be stopped to prevent data loss. You should prune unused data or upgrade your disk space.
disk.pruneNote: Prune unused data in order to free up disk space. This is also done automatically every night.

backup.title: Backup
backup.nightly: A backup is done automatically every night. New backups overwrite the old ones. Even after your Shard is deleted, you can still access your backups.
backup.selfService: We are currently working on self-service access to your backups. Until then, please contact us if you need access, so we can guide you through the process.
backup.passphraseNote: Backups are encrypted on this Shard before being sent to the backup server. The encryption key is your personal passphrase. In order to access your backups later, it is essential to write down your passphrase. If you lose it, you will not be able to access your backups. There is no other way to recover them.
backup.neverViewed: You have never viewed your passphrase. Please write it down as soon as possible.
backup.sensitive: This is very sensitive information. Make sure no one else is watching!
backup.lastRevealed: Your passphrase was last revealed {when} from device {name} (ID: {id}).

size.title: Size
size.note: Change the size of your Shard. This sets the number of CPUs and the amount of RAM your Shard can use.
size.unlock: To unlock larger sizes, please contact us.
size.pending: A size change is already pending; new resizes are disabled until it completes.

language.title: Language
language.note: Choose the language of this interface.

tours.title: Reset welcome screen
tours.note: Reset the welcome screen so you can look at it again.

restart.title: Restarting Shard
restart.stillAlive: Shard is still alive and kicking. Maybe something went wrong. Try again or contact support.
restart.wentDown: Shard went down, waiting for restart
restart.bePatient: Be patient, sometimes it may take a moment
restart.lotToDo: Perhaps this time there is a lot to do...
restart.strange: Something is strange, it usually does not take so long
restart.wentWrong: It seems like something went wrong. Better contact support.
restart.reallyPatient: Wow, you are really patient. But this Shard is most probably broken. You should really contact support.
restart.knockKnock: Knock knock! Is someone there? This Shard broke down and needs help. Please contact support.
